description: #6608 — `edit_blocks_batch` writes each edit whose block still holds the content the caller read, and answers with the blocks it left alone: one edited since (S3) and one in the Trash (S4). An empty list is refused. An edit the single command refuses (a tag renamed to a name holding a space) fails the whole batch, and the edit before it is not written.
name: edit_blocks_batch

ops.comment: S3 changes after the caller read `beta needle`.
ops.name: a_block_edited_since

ops.comment: S4 goes to the Trash after the caller read it.
ops.name: a_block_deleted_since

ops.comment: S2 is written. S3 keeps its newer text and S4 stays as it was in the Trash; both are named in `skipped`, in request order.
ops.name: one_written_two_left_alone

ops.comment: Nothing to write is a caller bug.
ops.name: an_empty_list_is_refused

ops.comment: The tag rename is refused, so S2 keeps `alpha pin`: no op for either.
ops.name: a_refused_edit_rolls_back_the_batch
